payload.summary: /medications/<unknown-slug> renders a bare 'Request failed (404)' instead of a not-found
payload.detail: use-medication-catalog.ts:192 throws 'Request failed (status)' and the record page renders that message. The breadcrumb still reads 'Medications / ZZZ' and the tab title 'Medication | PsychSift', implying the slug is a real drug record. Every other catalogue gives a named not-found with a route back. A stale bookmark reads as 'the system is broken' rather than 'that drug is not here'.
